entities.name: Amparo Poch y Gascón
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Amparo Poch y Gascón was a Spanish anarchist, 
pacifist, doctor, and activist in the years leading up to and during the Spanish Civil War. Poch y Gascón was born in Zaragoza.
